SAMPLE-100.title: Reminders: let members control how often they are reminded
SAMPLE-100.description:
Members get duplicate watering reminders. Give them control over frequency.

Requirements for child tickets:
- P1: Frequencies are Every day, Every 2 days and Every week.
- P2: Existing accounts default to Every week when unset.
- P3: A change applies to future reminders only.
- P4: Members without notification permission can view settings but cannot save until permission is enabled.
- P5: Save failures keep the chosen value and offer Retry.
- P6: English (LTR) and Arabic (RTL) are both supported.

Out of scope: delivery backend, push permission prompts, email channel.
